title: Kev Tswj Xyuas Ib Puag Ncig Thiab Lub Luag Haujlwm Ntawm Tib Neeg
blurb: Clean water, forests, animals, and the shared responsibility to protect the world for future generations.

paragraphs.hmong: Lub ntiajteb no muaj ntau yam khoom muaj nuj nqis xws li dej huv, huab cua zoo, hav zoov ntsuab, thiab tsiaj txhu ntau hom.
paragraphs.english: This world has many valuable things such as clean water, good air, green forests, and many species of animals.

paragraphs.hmong: Txij li thaum tib neeg pib tsim kho vaj tse thiab cog qoob loo ntau zog, ib puag ncig tau raug kev puas tsuaj ntau heev.
paragraphs.english: Ever since people began building and farming more intensively, the environment has suffered a great deal of damage.

paragraphs.hmong: Cov tshuaj lom, pa roj avgas, thiab khoom pov tseg tau ua rau av thiab dej qias neeg kawg.
paragraphs.english: Chemicals, exhaust fumes, and waste have caused the land and water to become seriously polluted.

paragraphs.hmong: Cov kws tshawb fawb tau ceeb toom tias yog peb tsis hloov peb txoj kev coj ua sai sai, ntau hom tsiaj txhu yuav ploj ntais mus ib txhis.
paragraphs.english: Researchers have warned that if we do not change our ways quickly, many species of animals will disappear forever.

paragraphs.hmong: Kev hloov pauv ntawm huab cua yuav ua rau nag xob nag cua loj tuaj ntxiv.
paragraphs.english: Changes in the weather will make storms grow larger and more severe.

paragraphs.hmong: Yog li ntawd, txhua tus neeg muaj lub luag haujlwm los tiv thaiv ib puag ncig rau peb cov tub ki xeeb ntxwv.
paragraphs.english: Therefore, every person has a responsibility to protect the environment for our future generations and descendants.

paragraphs.hmong: Tsoom fwv kuj yuav tsum muab kev cai lij choj los tswj cov koom haum lag luam kom tsis txhob pov tseg cov khoom uas ua rau ib puag ncig puas tsuaj.
paragraphs.english: Governments must also establish laws to regulate businesses so they do not dispose of materials that harm the environment.

paragraphs.hmong: Tiamsis, kev hloov pib los ntawm txhua tus neeg ib leeg ib leeg.
paragraphs.english: However, change begins with each individual person.

paragraphs.hmong: Peb yuav ua tau li ntawd los ntawm tsis ua khoom pov tseg ntau, cog ntoo ntxiv, thiab siv hluav taws xob los ntawm hnub ci thiab cua.
paragraphs.english: We can do this by producing less waste, planting more trees, and using energy from the sun and wind.

paragraphs.hmong: Peb haiv neeg Hmoob suav daws tau nyob ze rau ib puag ncig los ntev lawm.
paragraphs.english: All of us Hmong people have lived close to nature for a long time.

paragraphs.hmong: Yog li kev hwm thiab tu ib puag ncig yog ib feem ntawm peb li kab lis kev cai uas peb yuav tsum coj mus rau yav pem suab.
paragraphs.english: Therefore, respecting and caring for the environment is part of our cultural heritage that we must carry forward into the future.
